name: Epic E1000 / LT
variants: Epic E1000 / E1000 GX / GT / AX (certified)
summary: Fast single-engine turboprop with an all-composite airframe, a long tapering nose and a pressurized cabin.

wings: Low, tapered wing with no winglets
Wing roots blend smoothly into the fuselage
engines: Single PT6A turboprop in a long nose
fuselage: Smooth composite fuselage with a long tapering nose
Large oval windows and a sweeping windshield
Main door at the rear left
tail: Swept fin with a dorsal fillet

tellTales: Single-engine turboprop with a very long, smooth, tapering nose
Low tailplane (not a T-tail) on a sleek composite body

confusedWith.howToTell: The TBM has smaller rectangular windows and a shorter nose (900-series has winglets); the Epic has large oval windows, a longer nose and no winglets.
The PC-12 has a T-tail and a boxy, slab-sided fuselage; the Epic is a smooth, tapered composite aircraft with a low tail.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
